protocol.name: unity_spatial_preview_unstable
protocol.description: The unity-spatial-preview plugin draws live windows into subsurfaces of the shell.

interface.name: zunity_preview_manager
interface.description: Draws live windows into subsurfaces of the client. The client places, sizes, stacks and synchronizes each subsurface with wl_subsurface and wp_viewport. The compositor draws only the window.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: the surface is not a subsurface

request.name: get_preview

description.summary: draw a window into a surface

request.description: Draws the window view_id into the surface. The compositor scales the window so that its frame fills the surface, draws the window's client-side shadow around the surface, draws above the surface's own content and clips to the parent surface. It starts when the parent surface commits the subsurface, draws only while the surface has a buffer, and stops when the window unmaps. For an unknown or unmapped window it draws nothing. The surface must have the wl_subsurface role.

arg.name: view_id
arg.summary: wayfire view id of the window

description.summary: a window drawn into a surface
stop drawing the window into the surface
